details:
You can see that people are going a bit too much with this NSFW things, personally I think VRChat should be the platform of playing with eachother across the globe and just chilling, and well tho, there are some people who think this is not the normal thing to do.

They just go around public places with kinda suggestive avatars which are not the best, eventually the trust rank system sucks sometimes at filtering these avatars. I would say that the whole VRChat internal in-game security system and management would need a re-work, but lets leave it for now.

I would suggest that VRChat would actually start hiring mods/volunteers to go around the games actively and filter these people out manually, or just simply ban/block all NSFW avatars disallowing people to commit NSFW stuff. Like guys, be normal and stop being horny. It is not good, you are not going to remain in this age forever, and in the future you might regret your actions, so why do it?

I think VRChat could even create a whole department just for this, and to not rise the expenses of the company itself, build it up from volunteers who would like to take this job. I am sure there would be a lot of people who think the same as me, and would eventually like to help VRChat in becoming a more SFW place instead of an NSFW platform. Soon enough, VRChat will be filled  with so much NSFW, that eventually the whole platform will revolve around that. 

And you might say that it is one of the things that keep the game alive, but just look at Roblox... see? They still face no issues, and while VRChat is highly similar to Roblox with community-led in-game features, they are still different in terms of age safety. So, why make all the verification systems or anything that would make the lives of normal people who just want to chill harder when you could just enforce the Terms better?

There are a plently of stuff you can do so the people will actually stick to the terms.
title: NSFW problem. - (Suggestion on how to fix it.)
